svg.title: Three activation functions and their derivatives
svg.desc: Solid curves are the activations, dashed curves their derivatives. The sigmoid's derivative peaks at 0.25 at z = 0 and vanishes for large |z|; tanh's peaks at 1 and also vanishes at both ends; ReLU's is 0 for negative z and exactly 1 for positive z, so it never saturates on the positive side.
